I re-derived the schedule from the 21 constraints. It satisfies all of them, and a case analysis on slot 1 shows no other arrangement works.

Slot 1 must be Finn or Ivo, since everyone else has someone required before them. Finn at slot 1 forces Ann to slot 3, Ivo to slot 2, and then Cara at 7 or 8, which leaves only Cara at 8 consistent. Ivo at slot 1 leads to contradictions in every case for Finn's slot.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Finn","2":"Ivo","3":"Ann","4":"Gus","5":"Elif","6":"Dev","7":"Ben","8":"Cara","9":"Hana"}
